name: Stormbringer: Flux Arc marks and splashes, Sparks debuffs its two sources (#665, #1811)
contract: #665 Flux Arc 705643 (Spell.dbc, server set /srv/coa/server-data/dbc): PASSIVE, ProcFlags 0, Effect[0] APPLY_AURA with EffectApplyAuraName 354 (nullptr in the core handler table, SpellAuraEffects.cpp:419), EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1 = 15 and EffectTriggerSpell 705644. ProcFlags 0 with no spell_proc row means SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips the spell entirely (SpellMgr.cpp:2255-2257), so neither the mark nor the splash could ever fire. The mark aura is 804832 'Flux Arc' (APPLY_AURA, SPELL_AURA_DUMMY, TargetA 6 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms in SpellDuration.dbc); the splash is 705644 'Flux Arc' (SCHOOL_DAMAGE, TargetB 16 DEST_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex 8 = 5 yd, MaxAffectedTargets 5, SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS + SPELL_ATTR6_IGNORE_CASTER_DAMAGE_MODIFIERS, i.e. a flat value fed by the caster). Forked Lightning 501438 and Arm of Thorim 501433 now apply the mark; Call Lightning 500040 on a marked enemy casts 705644 for 15% of the hit it just dealt, the aura amount asserted here. The splash value itself is stat-dependent, so the scenario asserts the cast and its damage event, not an absolute number. #1811 Sparks 301298: PASSIVE, ProcFlags 0, Effect[1] SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL with EffectTriggerSpell 706729 and an all-zero EffectSpellClassMask, so the same LoadSpellProcs gate applies and a bare proc row could not tell the two promised sources apart. 706729 'Sparks' is native and correct: SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE, EffectMiscValue 127, EffectBasePoints 2 + EffectDieSides 1 = 3, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms, matching the tooltip's '3% for 10 sec'. Electrocute 501421 and Arm of Thorim 501433 now apply it; Forked Lightning must not. Dummies stand 3, 15, 26 and 32 yards out so that Forked Lightning's 4 chain targets (10 yd jump radius, Spell.cpp:2160-2190) cannot reach a neighbouring fixture, and each spell's 35 yd range (SpellRange.dbc id 35) still covers all four. Call Lightning 500040 is gated by the Stormbringer 'Static' custom resource (AscensionCustomResourceData.h ResourceCostRules: class 16, spell 500040, resource 803102, amount 50, Fixed): AscensionCompat.cpp CheckCast returns SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER when GetAuraStacks(player, 803102) < 50, independent of POWER_MANA, so each Call Lightning cast needs a set_aura on 803102 (StackAmount max 100 per Spell.dbc) immediately beforehand. Electrocute 501421 also has TargetAuraState 13 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT (SharedDefines.h), which Unit::Update only recomputes once per tick, so the scenario drops 'shocked' to 300000 of its 1000000 max health and waits 2000 ms before each cast. Arm of Thorim 501433 has its own ResourceCostRule (class 16, spell 501433, resource 803102, amount 1, Consumption::All) independent of Call Lightning's rule, so its cast also needs a set_aura on 803102 immediately beforehand.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

BASELINE: Call Lightning casts no Flux Arc splash without the talent
Let Unit::Update refresh the aura state
BASELINE: Electrocute applies no Sparks debuff without the talent

DERIVATION: Flux Arc effect 0 carries the 15% of EffectBasePoints 14 + EffectDieSides 1
SETUP: the Sparks passive is active
CONTROL: Call Lightning on an unmarked enemy still casts no splash
DISCRIMINATING: Forked Lightning marks the enemy with Flux Arc 804832
The mark runs on its own SpellDuration id 1 of 10000 ms, less the time since it landed
DISCRIMINATING: Call Lightning on the marked enemy casts the 705644 splash once
DISCRIMINATING: the splash deals its 15% of the Call Lightning hit as damage
Let Unit::Update refresh the aura state
DISCRIMINATING: Electrocute applies the Sparks debuff 706729
Sparks grants the DBC value of +3% crit taken (EffectBasePoints 2 + EffectDieSides 1)
Sparks runs on SpellDuration id 1 of 10000 ms, less the time since it landed
Let Electrocute's global cooldown clear before casting Arm of Thorim
DISCRIMINATING: Arm of Thorim applies the Sparks debuff too
DISCRIMINATING: Arm of Thorim is the second Flux Arc marker
CONTROL: Forked Lightning is not a Sparks source
CONTROL: the same Forked Lightning hit still applies the Flux Arc mark
